outline: １.TTL，CMOS邏輯閘之特性實習２.組合邏輯電路設計實習含：算術電路，比較器，解碼器，編碼器，多工器，解多工器等３.序向邏輯電路設計與應用：正反器，計數器，記錄器，及移位暫存器等綜合應用４.FPGA設計規劃。
schedule:
Week 1	General Announcement and lab Administration (SDY, KWK)
Week 2	Lab 0: Use of lab equipment (SDY)
Week 3	Lab 1: Logic pen (SDY)
Week 4    Lab 2: TTL and CMOS oscillators. 555 Astable multivibratiors (KWK)
Week 5    Lab 3: Simple combinational logic I (SDY)
Week 6 	Lab 3: Simple combinational logic II (SDY)
Week 7    Lab 4: Using 7-segment display (KWK)
Week 8    Lab 5: Monostable and Schmitt trigger (KWK)
Week 9    Lab 6: Combinational Circuit Design Using FPGA I (SDY)
Week 10	Lab 6: Combinational Circuit Design Using FPGA II (SDY)
Week 11	Lab 7: Sequential logic I (KWK)
Week 12	Lab 7:  Sequential logic II (KWK)
Week 13  Lab 8: Sequential circuit design using FPGA I (SDY)
Week 14	Lab 8: Sequential circuit design using FPGA II (SDY)
Week 15  Lab 9: PLL or small Project I (KWK)
Week 16  Lab 9: PLL or small Project II (KWK)
Week 17	Final exam (SDY, KWK)
assessment:
Participation and check off worked circuits: 60%
Lab reports: 20 %
Final exam: 20 % (*)
* The final exam covers basic knowledge students should know to successfully complete the lab experiments. Students whose final exam scores below 33 points are determined not to have enough knowledge to complete the experiments independently. Therefore, the instructor reserve the rights not count the points of some worked circuits and reports for these students.
